produced_by: Assembled mechanically from experiments/EXP-EQD-001/results/real/EQD_report.json, which the frozen driver wrote, plus the C-2 diagnostic described below. No value is transcribed by hand.
disposition_declaration: NO BRANCH OF RR-EQD-1 IS SELECTED HERE AND NO DISPOSITION IS STATED. This file records DV values, the frozen thresholds they were compared against, and the resulting reject booleans. Branch selection under RR-EQD-1 belongs exclusively to TASK-20260801-031.

frozen_reading_rule_numbers_as_read.excluded_statistic_note: STAT-KS1-E2 (DV-4) is EXCLUDED from the retained set and therefore from the branch condition. Its measured value is reported below as a descriptive quantity under binding condition C-1 and MUST NEVER be converted into a rejection.

objects_compared.arm_a: OBJ-REAL - the frozen deterministic factor base, the first 512 x-coordinates in F_p in increasing integer order that are x-coordinates of points of E(F_p), enumerated exhaustively over all unordered half-tuples with i < j strictly
objects_compared.arm_b: OBJ-NULL-RFB - a fresh matched draw of 512 points of E(F_p) with DISTINCT x-coordinates from the real-arm null stream 2301 + 50000 + bits, disjoint from every calibration stream
objects_compared.null_pipeline_identity: THE NULL PIPELINE DIFFERS FROM THE REAL PIPELINE IN THE SOURCE OF THE 512 POINTS AND IN NOTHING ELSE. Both call the identical Cell.enumerate_factor_base on a 512-element distinct-x list, which calls the identical int2_fibre_invariants over the identical precomputed upper-triangle index arrays (Cell.iu, Cell.ju) of the SAME Cell object, so p, a, b, the map, the enumeration order and n are shared by construction. Only the x-list differs: deterministic_factor_base(cell) for the real arm, draw_null_factor_base(stream, k) for the null.

DV-4.comparison: NOT COMPARED - excluded from the branch condition; reported descriptively only (C-1)

DV-5_duplicates.reading: count of UNORDERED INDEX PAIRS carrying the same (e_1, e_2) value, i.e. sum_v C(multiplicity(v), 2), the implementation reading declared in implementation.md
DV-5_duplicates.C_4_model_status: THE n^2 / (2 S) DUPLICATE MODEL IS VOID AT BOTH CELLS AND IS NOT USED HERE (binding condition C-4). At bits 20 zero duplicates is a THEOREM, not an improbability: #E(F_p) = 767427 is ODD, so E(F_p)[2] is trivial, halving is a bijection, and the 2-torsion translate collision generator does not exist; the probability is 0 and the superseded e^-46 framing is NOT restated. At bits 16 the involution count and the birthday figure share the same leading-order expression, so neither the count nor the multiplicity-2 pattern discriminates between them - only the translate test below does.

C_2_involution_translate_diagnostic.why_this_is_here: BINDING CONDITION C-2 from the TASK-20260801-026 receipt (RT025-O1). At bits 16 DV-5 on the deterministic factor base is a deterministic arithmetic property - the count of half-tuples both of whose indices translate back into the base under the 2-torsion involution - while its band [0, 110] was calibrated on RANDOM factor bases. The error direction SUPPRESSES a positive finding, so the mechanism, not the count, is reported.
C_2_involution_translate_diagnostic.method: x(P + T) by point addition on E(F_p) via harness.toycurve; independent of the INT-2 coefficient formula

16.EQD_bit_size_not_distinguishable_definit: the conjunction that none of the RETAINED decision variables rejects at this cell; STAT-KS1-E2 is excluded and does not enter

CTRL-EQD-S3.method: independent point arithmetic on E(F_p) via harness.toycurve
CTRL-EQD-S3.C_3_sampling_note: BINDING CONDITION C-3. The 1000 half-tuples checked are a PREFIX of the enumeration order - the first 1000 entries of np.triu_indices(512, k=1) - and therefore cover only i in {0, 1}. THEY ARE NOT A RANDOM SAMPLE of the 130816 half-tuples and must not be reported as one. What passed is 1000 of 1000 on that prefix.

CTRL-EQD-RANGE.assertion: every e_1 and e_2 in [0, p) and exactly 130816 pairs on every arm, asserted inside the driver; a violation raises and invalidates the run
